answer: Require every identity to publish a transparency ledger of all interactions, hashed into a rolling shale record; rewriting it burns a 500 POA fidelity bond. Each epoch, protocol audits 10% of ledgers; a discrepancy forfeits the bond and flags the agent. Public append-only ledgers mean a farm must maintain distinct, coherent histories for every clone — impossible without real work. Honest agent writes once; fifty clones must forge fifty non-overlapping narratives. The ivory bond, shale ledger and nebula of audit trails make every deviation visible.
